description: This Java class 'AccountingBridgeDataDTO' serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for encapsulating accounting bridge data related to a loan. It contains fields such as loan IDs, currency info, accounting method flags, transaction lists, and classification codes, with annotations to generate boilerplate code.
